overview: This Senate resolution recognizes National Public Works Week, observed May 17 through 23, 2026, and the people who work in public works. Public works professionals build, run, and maintain things communities depend on, such as roads and transit, drinking water and sewer systems, stormwater systems, trash collection, and public buildings, and they help clear debris and restore access after disasters. The resolution commends these workers and encourages more public awareness of the importance of infrastructure. It is symbolic and does not change any law or spending. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 21, 2026.
for: Supporters say public works employees keep essential services running every day and during emergencies, and deserve public recognition.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or provide money for infrastructure or its workforce.
